Log in with email 'qa-test-journeyhawk@phronex.com' and password 'HMqt4kH5loXkeAtvQSndQ7zNmow!Phx#9'. Wait for the portal to load — verify no 500 error and the sidebar is visible.

The dashboard main area should show stat cards (Org Health, Active Agents, Pending Approvals).
